name: meta-Camphorene

pubchem.title: m-Camphorene
pubchem.description: Gamma-camphorene is a cycloalkene that is cyclohexene substituted by 2-methylpent-2-en-5-yl and 6-methylhepta-1,5-dien-2-yl groups at positions 1 and 5, respectively. It is a diterpene isolated from several plant species. It has a role as a volatile oil component. It is a cycloalkene and a diterpene.

evidence: Measured in 2 of 6 MONDAYS hemp SKUs at 0.05–0.17% of total volatiles (0.01–0.034mg per chew).

consumer_summary.what_it_is: meta-Camphorene (often referred to as gamma-camphorene) is a diterpene, a type of aromatic molecule that helps make up the volatile essential oils of certain plants. As a cycloalkene, its complex ring structure makes it an interesting piece of the natural chemical puzzle you might encounter when smelling fresh plant extracts.
consumer_summary.found_in: It is isolated from the volatile oils of several different plant species, though it is not widely cataloged as a primary component of common culinary foods.
consumer_summary.why_researchers_care: Diterpenes as a family are famous for their wide-ranging biological activities, which makes members like meta-camphorene structurally intriguing to phytochemists. At present, however, it remains a blank slate in the medical literature, with no published studies (Oxford level 5, none found) exploring what it might do in the human body.
consumer_summary.evidence_at_a_glance: There is currently no published research or clinical evidence available evaluating the health effects of this molecule.
